The Founders Office Associate works closely with the founders across all areas of organisation building. This is a central role that touches strategy, operations, research, partnerships, product development, communication, and internal process creation. You will act as an extension of the founders team to drive progress on high priority work and help the company scale with clarity and speed.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Support

  • Work with founders on company strategy, planning, and key decisions

  • Support creation of business models, investor material, market analysis, and reports

  • Conduct research across new sectors, partners, regulations, and emerging opportunities

Operations and Execution

  • Drive cross functional projects to completion

  • Build internal processes for planning, tracking, and reporting

  • Manage special projects across product, supply chain, marketing, and growth

  • Improve coordination between teams and ensure timely execution of tasks

Organisational Development

  • Support hiring, onboarding, and culture building initiatives

  • Work with founders to design reviews, goal setting, and company wide communication

  • Prepare material for board meetings, investor updates, and internal reviews

External Relations

  • Assist founders in managing key partners, clients, advisors, and government bodies

  • Prepare briefs, presentations, proposals, and meeting notes

  • Represent the organisation in meetings when required

Product and Innovation Support

  • Assist with product research, testing, documentation, and roll out

  • Coordinate with design, engineering, and production teams to gather insights and unblock tasks


Requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • 3-10 years of experience in consulting, venture capital, early stage startups, or fast paced roles

  • Strong problem solving skills, detail orientation, and an ability to learn fast

  • Excellent written and verbal communication

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a strong sense of ownership

  • Ability to work directly with founders and handle sensitive information

  • Curiosity across business, design, sustainability, and operations


Benefits

  • Be part of amission-firstteam solving real environmental challenges
  • Shape the narrative ofIndia’s next-generation materials brand
  • ​Experience startup life up close—at theintersection of design, science, and scale
  • Opportunity to grow into leadership roles across design, marketing, or product strategy

About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect high-performing professionals with global companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries like SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. We match top talent to full-time remote roles where they’re hired directly into client teams and provided ongoing support by Huzzle.

Role Type: Full-time

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Job Summary

We’re looking for a highly organized, analytical, and proactive Founder’s Associate to work directly with the CEO and help drive execution across multiple companies.

In this role, you will act as a strategic operator and execution partner, translating high-level ideas into structured plans, systems, and results. You’ll manage cross-company projects, implement operational processes, build internal dashboards and documentation, and help remove operational bottlenecks so the founder and teams can focus on growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Project Execution
    • Drive execution of high-priority initiatives across real estate, hospitality, and SaaS ventures.
    • Translate high-level strategic ideas from the founder into clear plans, timelines, and deliverables.
    • Own projects end-to-end, ensuring successful implementation and measurable outcomes.
    • Help accelerate execution velocity across multiple business initiatives.
  • Operations & Systems Development
    • Design and implement scalable operational systems, SOPs, and playbooks.
    • Build and maintain a centralized operations hub and knowledge base.
    • Identify inefficiencies and improve workflows through automation and process optimization.
    • Implement systems that allow the companies to scale efficiently.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination
    • Coordinate projects between internal teams, contractors, vendors, developers, and partners.
    • Ensure initiatives remain aligned across different business units.
    • Track project timelines, progress, and deliverables to maintain execution momentum.
  • Data, Reporting & Insights
    • Build dashboards and reporting systems to track business performance and operational metrics.
    • Organize operational data across ventures and surface actionable insights.
    • Support strategic decision-making through research, analytics, and reporting.
  • Growth & Opportunity Development
    • Conduct market research and competitive analysis across real estate, hospitality, and SaaS sectors.
    • Identify potential growth opportunities, partnerships, and new product initiatives.
    • Assist with launching and scaling new ventures and initiatives.
  • Founder Support
    • Act as a trusted operational partner to the CEO.
    • Manage priorities, coordinate projects, and ensure consistent follow-through.
    • Take ownership of complex tasks requiring judgment, initiative, and problem-solving.
    • Increase founder leverage by removing operational bottlenecks.

Requirements

Core Qualifications

  • Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills.
  • Exceptional organization and project management abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work in fast-paced startup environments with shifting priorities.
  • Self-starter mindset with a proactive approach to solving problems.
  • Ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.

Professional Experience

  • Background in consulting, startup operations, strategy, or venture-backed companies is highly preferred.
  • Experience building SOPs, operational systems, or documentation frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of business operations, project management, and scaling processes.

Tools & Technology

  • Experience using AI tools for productivity and automation.
  • Familiarity with:
    • CRM platforms (e.g., HubSpot, GoHighLevel)
    • Google Workspace
    • Notion or documentation systems
    • Slack
    • Automation tools such as Zapier or n8n

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in real estate, hospitality, or short-term rental operations.
  • Familiarity with STR tools such as Guesty, Conduit, Breezeway, or SuiteOp.
  • Bilingual English / Spanish is a plus.
  • Experience working with high-growth startups or founder-led companie

Benefits

💻 Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with international teams

🚀 Career Growth: Join companies in SaaS, MarTech, and B2B services

🤝 Peer Community: Connect with high-performing sales professionals in our network

🧭 Ongoing Support: Receive guidance from Huzzle before and after placement

💰 Tailored Compensation: Salaries vary by client and candidate preference — we’ll match you with options that fit your goals

Norman is building an AI accountant that helps small businesses manage invoicing, accounting, and taxes. We’re a small team based in Berlin.

As Founder's Associate, you’ll work directly with the founders across the full customer loop. You’ll talk to customers in German, help them get into the product, support them when they’re stuck, and help them decide whether to buy—honestly, not with a hard sell. Beyond that, you’ll take on business development, product feedback, and ops work that keeps Norman moving. This is a broad early-stage role across customer success, support, BD, product, and ops.

Full-time, remote within Germany.

Tasks

  • Take inbound calls and chats with people who found Norman and want to know if it fits their business.
  • Run demos and guided walkthroughs in German, tailored to their workflow. Help people onboard: setup, first tasks, and day-to-day product questions.
  • Identify product gaps and opportunities for improvement from these conversations. Help get them to production.
  • Own the purchase conversation: clarify fit, handle objections, and help suitable customers decide and get started. No sales quota or commission today—judgment and follow-through matter more than pressure.
  • Support current users when they’re stuck or considering next steps (customer support + success).
  • Help with business development: partnerships, outbound experiments, and turning strong conversations into pipeline where it makes sense.
  • Use Norman every day, catch friction early, and feed clear examples back into product.
  • Work with founders on product priorities: document recurring questions, objections, and workflow gaps; help turn them into better onboarding, help content, and product decisions.
  • Take on ops work that keeps a small company running smoothly (process, tools, follow-ups, light project ownership).
  • Help with webinars, short product videos, or a small community as we grow education around Norman.

Requirements

  • Native-level German (spoken and written) for confident, natural customer conversations.
  • Willingness to wear many hats in an early-stage startup—CS, support, BD, product feedback, and ops in the same week.
  • Strong listening: ask useful questions, explain software patiently, and avoid jargon.
  • You learn products and processes fast and care why people (and systems) get stuck.
  • You stay organized and follow through across calls, tickets, BD threads, and internal ops.
  • Based in Germany.

Nice to have:

  • SaaS/fintech experience or experience with tools for Freiberufler and small businesses.
  • Familiarity with invoicing, bookkeeping, or German tax workflows (no Steuerberater required).
  • CRM experience; you’ve done demos, support, partnerships, or light ops/project work before.
  • Interest in teaching in public (webinars, short videos, community).

Benefits

  • Work remotely within Germany.
  • Direct work with founders in a small team—high ownership, real impact.
  • Broad mandate across customers, product, and the company—not a siloed role.
  • Your feedback and work show up quickly in how Norman grows.

Interested? Send your CV or LinkedIn plus a short note covering your customer-facing (or early-startup) experience, why this role, and one example of helping someone get unstuck—a customer, a process, or a product.

About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 120 employees from a broad range of nations, we continue to grow – and we're now going far beyond our core business, aiming to eliminate bureaucracy and admin in hospitals with a whole portfolio of AI products.

This is what you can expect from us as a Founder’s Associate (m/w/d):

  • Work with Purpose — Your work has a real impact on patients and healthcare professionals. By helping our CEO and leadership team turn priorities into action, you contribute to improving healthcare.

  • Work Closely with Our Founder — Gain direct exposure to company-building, strategic decisions, and leadership. You’ll take ownership of meaningful work and see its impact across the business.

  • Corporate Culture — We embrace structures that foster high performance and strong team dynamics. Our interactions are characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. We work towards common goals and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility — As a remote-first company, we offer flexible working hours and the flexibility to work from anywhere in Germany. By arrangement, you’re also welcome to take a workation.

  • Probonio — Choose a benefit that suits you best, from gift cards to fitness.

  • Professional Development — Your development matters to us. We support you in building your capabilities, taking on responsibility, and growing in your role.

  • Extra Day Off on Your Birthday — So you can celebrate with your loved ones.

Requirements

This is how you will make an impact as a Founder’s Associate:

Your mission is to make our founder more effective every week. Working directly with our CEO, Max, you will help turn company priorities into a clear leadership rhythm, well-prepared decisions, and reliable execution.

  • Keep the CEO focused on what matters. Manage priorities, coordinate the founder’s agenda, and prepare key internal and external meetings so that time and attention go towards the highest-impact topics.

  • Run our leadership rhythm. Own the preparation and follow-through of our Exec Sync and other leadership formats—from agendas and pre-reads to decision logs and action tracking.

  • Turn strategy into accountability. Support Max in running our Must-Win Battles goal framework. Coordinate review cycles, make progress and blockers visible, and follow up with directors on their commitments on behalf of the CEO.

  • Close the loop on decisions. Track CEO and leadership decisions through implementation, ensuring clear owners, deadlines, and timely escalation when work gets stuck.

  • Prepare clear, compelling communication. Draft CEO communications, presentations, and briefing materials for internal audiences, customers, hospitals, and other external stakeholders.

  • Drive selected strategic projects. Take ownership of time-boxed, cross-company initiatives—from structuring the problem to coordinating delivery and handing over to a clear long-term owner.

  • Put AI into practice in the CEO Office. Become a hands-on user of agents built on Recare’s internal AI operating system. Help embed them into daily workflows while ensuring their use meets Recare’s governance and project standards.


Your Profile:

  • You have experience turning priorities into results. You bring relevant experience from a founder’s office, business operations, consulting, project management, or another fast-paced environment where you coordinated complex work and delivered outcomes.

  • You bring structure to ambiguity. You can break an open-ended challenge into clear questions, priorities, owners, and next steps—without creating unnecessary process.

  • You follow through. You are organized, dependable, and comfortable keeping senior stakeholders accountable. You know when to resolve an issue yourself and when to escalate.

  • You communicate with clarity and judgment. You can turn complex information into concise briefings, effective presentations, and actionable meeting materials.

  • You build trust across functions. You collaborate confidently with senior leaders and colleagues, challenge constructively, and handle sensitive information with discretion.

  • You combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You are as comfortable preparing a decision as you are maintaining an action tracker or coordinating the details that make a meeting productive.

  • You are curious about AI and thoughtful about its use. You enjoy testing tools, improving workflows, and applying AI responsibly to practical business problems.

  • You care about making healthcare work better. You are motivated by meaningful impact and want to help build a company that improves the experience of patients and healthcare professionals.

We’re looking forward to receiving your application!

JustPlay is looking for an experienced and business-oriented Founders Associate - Engagement Innovation to help us make JustPlay app ecosystem dramatically more fun, exciting and engaging.

You'll work directly with our founders across every product team, constantly looking for ideas that make users want to click, play, win, explore and come back.

We're not looking for someone to manage roadmaps or introduce more product processes. We're looking for someone with exceptional consumer instincts, extremely high agency and an obsession with the mechanics behind the world's most engaging B2C products.

You should be the kind of person who opens an app like TikTok, Temu, MONOPOLY GO!, Duolingo or Whatnot and immediately starts dissecting why it works and how those ideas could be applied somewhere completely different.

Some of your ideas may become major features. Others might be a different CTA, a more exciting reward reveal, a new event, better framing of a prize, or an experiment we can ship next week.

We care much more about the impact of an idea than its complexity.

Job Responsibilities

  • Work directly with the founders as a thinking partner on what makes JustPlay exciting to play

  • Embed across product teams to find opportunities — not to run them

  • Maintain a constant flow of ideas, from single-line copy changes to entirely new mechanics

  • Tear down the world's most engaging consumer apps and translate what works there into what could work here

  • Turn ideas into things people can act on: a sharp one-pager, a mock, a test plan — whatever gets it moving fastest

  • Push ideas through to launch by making yourself useful to the teams shipping them

  • Measure what happens, tell the truth about it, and scale or kill accordingly

  • Build our collective instinct for engagement, so the whole company gets better at this over time

The Role

We run the business on internal tools we built ourselves with AI, and the whole team uses them every day.

These tools need an owner. Bugs come in and features get requested. Some of those requests are great and some would break three other things. We need someone who can tell the difference, fix what matters fast, and push back on what doesn't.

This is a product role as much as a building role. The code is the easy part now. What matters is knowing what to build, why it matters to the business, and making it something people actually enjoy using.

This is not a software engineering role. You'll build with AI tools, not write everything from scratch. But you need to understand what's happening under the hood well enough to know when a fix in one place will cause a problem somewhere else.

You'll work directly with our COO and CCO.

What you'll do

  • Own the bug and feature queue for our internal tools. Triage requests, prioritise by business impact, fix it, ship it.
  • Talk to the people using the tools to understand the actual problem before building anything.

  • Fix bugs and ship small features using AI coding tools, and test properly before anything goes live.
  • Spot when a change could break something else, and flag it before it happens.
  • Keep things documented so the next fix is faster than the last one.
  • Over time, take on bigger projects that improve how the business runs.

Requirements

  • You have a business mind. You care about why something is being built and whether it moves a number, not just whether it works.

  • You understand the basics: how a database works, what an API does, how frontend and backend connect, what happens when you change a table someone else depends on.

Benefits

  • Fully remote.

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

This Role Is Not For

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally. 

This role is based in Malaysia. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Malaysia office at least 3 days per week.

  1. Online assessment or practical task
